name: axonsynth-inference
desc: 3D axon segmentation inference on a light-sheet microscopy (LSM) volume using AxonSynth's primary three_class_v2 MONAI 3D U-Net (background/shell/interior, collapsed to binary foreground). Runs with or without a GPU: falls back to CPU automatically unless require_cuda is set.

skip_prepare.desc: Skip the anisotropic-to-isotropic resample step; use only when input_volume is already isotropic at model spacing (0.8um by default).

target_spacing.desc: Target isotropic voxel size in microns for the prepare step. Ignored if skip_prepare is true.

axis_order.desc: Comma-separated permutation of 0,1,2 mapping model axes to source axes for the prepare step. Ignored if skip_prepare is true.

assume_source_units_micron.desc: Treat source NIfTI header zoom values as microns when the header does not declare micron units. Ignored if skip_prepare is true.

roi_size.desc: Isotropic sliding-window ROI size used during inference.

threshold.desc: Foreground probability threshold applied to produce the binary segmentation.

stitch_device.desc: Device used to stitch sliding-window logits: 'model' (default, same device as the model) or 'cpu' (for volumes that exceed GPU memory when stitched).

output_profile.desc: 'binary_focused' (default) writes only the collapsed foreground probability/mask; 'full' additionally writes the three-class argmax, shell, and interior masks.

require_cuda.desc: Fail instead of silently falling back to CPU when no GPU is available on the compute resource.

additional_thresholds.desc: Comma-separated LABEL=VALUE pairs for extra binary masks at additional probability thresholds, e.g. '0p94=0.94'. Empty means none.

inputs.desc: Raw or already-prepared 3D LSM microscopy volume (NIfTI).

outputs.desc: Predicted binary axon segmentation (AxonSynth three_class_v2, shell+interior collapsed to foreground) as parc.nii.gz, with label.json, plus the foreground probability map and inference metadata as extra files.
